Tell us about your band! What roles do you fill? What kind of music are you playing, and how many and what instruments are covered in your band?

My main band is a Celtic folk/rock duo comprised of myself and a fiddle player. I also have the singing duties. This band was once a 5 piece with a different lineup, but it pretty much exploded when our bass player left town. We are talking about bringing in some percussion, but we'll see how it goes. I'm the only original member. Funny thing, our fiddle player is a better guitarist than I'll ever be.

What about you?

I was in a punk band once in high school. I played six string guitar but they wanted me to play bass for a show at a roller skate rink. They never got around to practicing before so I essentially learned as we were performing. They told me I sucked at bass after and never invited me back. I've been playing guitar for 10+ years now--have yet to pick up another bass or play in another band. I've done plenty of open mics, usually filling in the other instruments with LMMS with my own samples.

At least I didn't get stabbed in the leg.

I hope you didn't let that one incident sour you on playing with a band. It's crazy to think that you could just sit in with a group and sound good playing a bunch of songs you've never even heard before without any lead sheets or anything.

Oh no, it's likely my social anxiety that prevents me from maintaining relationships with other musicians. I just thought you'd enjoy an anecdote. I really do just perform for myself. I can't get passionate if I am thinking about someone else and their impression of my music.

If you don't mind a bit of shameless self promotion, I write and play solo as Catfish Jones . A storyteller mainly, I play various instruments in a quest to get some songs out of my head and into a more permanent status before I eventually die (hopefully a very long time from now). I also play guitar and split vocals in a trio with my two best friends called Sons of Truckers. It's a lot of fun, but mostly restricted to Thursday's in a basement.
Cool stuff. Sounds a little bit Tom Petty. What kind of stuff do you do with Sons of Truckers, and what's the trio comprised of?

Truckers stuff is a bit harder to explain, but very similar to 70's rock. A lot of dual vocals and movey basslines. I play guitar which stays mostly on the rhythm side, though there are a few solos sprinkled about. The bassist and I write the music and words together with the main rule being not to write about girls (hard to break out of the pattern of writing about relationship problems). This leaves us room to write songs about things that we have never written about before like getting stuck on the surface of mars or runnin from the law, or even a dramatic fight between a vampire breakdancer and the DJ that hunts him.

That sounds awesome! I make it a point not to write about relationships myself. There's more than enough of that stuff out there already. I'd love to hear some of the Truckers stuff. You should record it.
